text:
aditya: FYI scheduling an 'edge probe' maintenance tonight 23:45 UTC. Purpose: exercise cross-region spillover, validate KV-cache reseed, and verify routing failover. Target: az-south2-gpu pool. Expected duration ~50m, parallelism=1.
ops-bot: Maintenance window created for pool 'az-south2-gpu' at 2026-04-02T23:45Z. Rolling cordon+drain+warm-reboot. No planned customer-visible downtime.
rachel: How many GPUs/nodes are we taking for this probe?
aditya: 8 GPUs across 4 nodes (gpu-south-12..15). We'll run canary -> verify -> continue. Exclude any nodes with nvlink fw 3xx or bios rev older than 2.1.
tom: Please avoid running during my oncall handoff (00:00-01:00 UTC). Can we shift earlier by 15m?
aditya: We can start 23:30 instead. Updated window and comms.
priya: Routing ask: pin label:dedicated -> eu-west1-burst for the window to protect p99 for SLA tenants. Do we have egress headroom cross-AZ?
aditya: eu-west1-burst has ~18% spare for the next 3h. We'll also open preemptible backfill for best-effort.
nate: Cost flag: cross-region burst + preemptible backfill will add ~$0.45k/hr incremental. Tagging to infra-ops for chargeback.
aditya: Opening JIRA INFRA-2031 and tagging cost center. Runbook snippet:
```bash
./runbooks/maintenance-edge-probe.sh 
--pool az-south2-gpu 
--nodes gpu-south-12,gpu-south-13,gpu-south-14,gpu-south-15 
--parallel 1 
--exclude-fw 3xx 
--post-hook ./tools/kv-reseed --timeout 300
```
ops-bot: Preflight checks: DR config OK, telemetry hooks OK, canary candidates gpu-south-12/gpu-south-13. Health probes green.
rachel: Rollback criteria? Also what happens if p50 jumps but p99 is stable?
aditya: Abort if any of: p50+ latency >30% sustained 10m OR error-rate >0.4% sustained 10m OR p99 > 2x baseline. If aborted, we'll uncordon in reverse and stop routing changes. Metrics will stream to #eng-runtime.
priya: Add cross-AZ egress sanity check in the run: curl to egress-probe endpoints, capture 95th latency.
aditya: Added post-check: curl -sS https://egress-probe.internal/status | jq .latency_95. Threshold=150ms.
tom: Also: ensure we don't pick nodes that were part of last week's backfill; last time they had high swap.
aditya: Good catch. Excluding nodes with last-evac < 72h. Script updated.
comms-bot: Notification queued: dedicated customers and slack-private-dedicated for 2026-04-02T22:45Z (1h prior). Template: maintenance_edge_probe_v2.
nate: Ops: please confirm monitoring handoff and paging window.
aditya: Paging covered: sam (primary), tom (secondary). I'll ping 15m before start in this thread. :alarm_clock:
priya: Thanks. Also log the incremental cost in the ticket so finance can reconcile.
aditya: Done (INFRA-2031). Ready to proceed once everyone ack's.
rachel: Ack.
tom: Ack.
priya: Ack.
nate: Ack.
aditya: Great — starting preflight checklist at T-20m.
ops-bot: Preflight runbook step 1/6: lock pool config, step 2/6: snapshot metrics baseline, step 3/6: verify routing policies.
aditya: Streaming baseline now to #eng-runtime.
